title: Two Rows, Two Channels
description: A shipment reaching its destination is important enough to reach the customer two different ways — prove that's really two separate outbox entries, not one message stamped with two channel labels.
successCondition: Advance a shipment to "delivered" status. After waiting past the queue delay, querying mock_messages via `npm run db:psql` for that user's id shows exactly 2 new rows for this event: one with channel = 'email' and one with channel = 'sms', each with its own independent id, and both with body content referencing the delivery. Confirm there is no single row somehow representing both channels at once.
hints: notify() (apps/api/src/modules/notifications/service.ts) does two separate prisma.mockMessage.create calls when both options.email and options.sms are true — never a single combined row.
shipment.delivered is the one event type in the table (docs/api/notifications.md) that sends on both channels — every other event type sends email only.
